Design.name: Adobe Express
Design.store: Unknown. Adobe says Creative Cloud for enterprise applications, including Adobe Express, are hosted in North America, Europe and Japan. Plan assumed: Adobe Express Premium from the nonprofit offer.
Design.aid: Adobe's General Terms of Use say: 'We will not use your Content to train generative AI models except for Content you chose to submit to the Adobe Stock marketplace.' Adobe also says content is never used to train partner AI models offered inside Adobe Express. Plan assumed: Adobe Express Premium (nonprofit offer).
Design.np: Adobe Express Premium is free for a year for up to 50 people at eligible charities and non-profits (250 generative credits a month, 100 GB storage). The UK page says beneficiaries, members and donors are not eligible; validation takes 1 to 3 business days. After the year, check what Adobe charges.
Design.note: The nonprofit offer is free for one year, so put the renewal date in your diary and check the price then. Ask Adobe where your Adobe Express files are stored. Download finished graphics as a copy outside Adobe. You can download designs as PDF, PowerPoint (.pptx), Photoshop (PSD) and GIF files. Each person turns on two-step verification in their own Adobe account. The offer is for staff only, so it does not cover volunteers unless they are part of your organisation.
